折叠多余空格，去掉中文之间、行首行尾的空白（换行保留）: Collapse extra spaces and trim whitespace between CJK characters and at the start and end of lines (line breaks are kept)
把排版断开的行接回一段；句末标点、列表、编号、表格的换行不动: Rejoin lines broken by layout; line breaks after sentence punctuation, in lists, numbered items and tables are kept
, ; : ! ? ( ) 等收成中文全角标点（不动小数点、网址）: Turn , ; : ! ? ( ) into full-width CJK punctuation (decimals and URLs are left alone)
整段英文转成小写（中文与符号不动）: Lowercase all English text (CJK and symbols are untouched)
每个单词的首字母大写，其余保持原样: Capitalize the first letter of every word and leave the rest as-is
每句话的第一个字母大写（按 . ! ? 和换行断句）: Capitalize the first letter of each sentence (split on . ! ? and line breaks)
对识别结果做文本处理（先划一段就只处理那一段）: Run text tools on the result (select a range to process only that part)
